title: 债务超40万亿：30年期收益率逼近6%，达利欧却说这其实很简单？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now is Ray Dalio, founder of Bridgewater Associates and one of the world's foremost thinkers and death cycles, market bubbles and the changing world order. Ray Dalio, good to have you with us, good to have you on insight.
segments.zh: 欢迎桥水基金创始人雷·达利欧，他是全球顶尖的思想者之一，研究债务周期、市场泡沫和世界秩序变迁。雷，很高兴你来到我们节目。

segments.en: It's always a pleasure to be here. Ray, you always talk about the five forces, one of which is the death cycle.
segments.zh: 很高兴再次做客。雷，你常谈五大力量，其中之一就是债务周期。

segments.en: We have a US with a debt of in-access of $40 trillion, no wonder not quite surprising that 30-year yields
segments.zh: 美国债务已超40万亿美元，30年期收益率逼近6%也不足为奇。

segments.en: had it towards 6 percent. How are you reading what's happening there?

I think it's just important to understand the mechanics. That's why I wrote the book How Countries Go Broke because there's a mechanical process and people don't understand it and it's really quite simple.
segments.zh: 理解机制很重要。我写《国家如何破产》就是因为这个过程有规律，但人们不懂，其实很简单。

segments.en: The way it works for countries is the same. It works for individuals except countries can print money.
segments.zh: 国家与个人的运作方式相同，区别在于国家可以印钞。

segments.en: One man's debts are another man's liability. What happens is when debts accumulate faster than they're paid back,
segments.zh: 一个人的债务是另一个人的资产。当债务积累快于偿还时，

segments.en: then debts service costs grow. That becomes a higher and higher percentage of one's cash flow.
segments.zh: 偿债成本就会增长，占现金流的比例越来越高。

segments.en: When that happens it starts to squeeze out spending and so then you have a problem.
segments.zh: 这就会挤压其他支出，问题随之而来。

segments.en: In the United States, so we have that dynamic as it squeeze it out, then also one man's assets or another man's liabilities for debt.
segments.zh: 美国正面临这种动态：支出被挤压，同时一方的资产对应另一方的债务。
